title: RepairJob
description: The diagnosis, quotation, authorisation and repair of a vehicle at a garage. Held in the eVault of the garage, because the garage is the only party that can author its own progress; the driver, the owner and the insurer read it and see the repair as it happens rather than waiting to be told. The work performed is additionally written back to the vehicle eVault as its own record, so the service history stays with the vehicle rather than with the garage that happened to do the work.

garageEName.description: eName of the garage doing the repair

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle being repaired

incidentEnvelopeId.description: Absent for a repair that was scheduled rather than caused by an incident

chainEnvelopeId.description: The chainEnvelopeId shared by the transport jobs that bring the vehicle in and take it back, so the repair reads as part of the same journey

inboundTransportJobEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the TransportJob that brings the vehicle to the garage

expectedArrivalAt.description: Known before the vehicle arrives, together with the incident history and the roadside condition report

intakeDecision.description: Whether the garage takes the vehicle in

intakeDeclineReason.description: Why the garage declined the vehicle

intakeConditionReportEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ConditionReport written when the vehicle arrived at the garage

roadsideConditionReportEnvelopeId.description: The report to compare the intake against. Differences are flagged rather than buried, which is the mechanism that removes damage disputes.

conditionDiscrepancies.description: Differences found between the roadside and intake condition reports

area.description: The panel or area that differs, using the area names of ConditionReport.damage

roadsideSeverity.description: Severity recorded for the area at the roadside

intakeSeverity.description: Severity recorded for the area at garage intake

note.description: What the difference is, for people

releaseConditionReportEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ConditionReport written when the vehicle left the garage

diagnosis.description: What the garage found wrong with the vehicle

unitPrice.description: Price of one, in the quote currency

parts.description: Parts the repair needs, one entry per part

labourHours.description: Hours of work the repair is expected to take

labourRate.description: Price of one hour of work, in the quote currency

total.description: Total of the quote, parts and labour together, in the quote currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount in the quote

quote.description: What the garage proposes to do and what it will cost, for the payer to authorise

insurerAuthorisationEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the insurer's decision on the quote. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

ownerAuthorisationEnvelopeId.description: Required where the driver is not the owner and the lease, rental or fleet company must approve

partsOrdered.description: Lead times are modelled but not yet confirmed as reliably available from suppliers

expectedAt.description: When the supplier expects to deliver the part

receivedAt.description: When the part arrived at the garage

status.description: Where the repair stands. Every change also writes a CaseEvent.

expectedCompletionAt.description: Updated when a parts lead time moves. A MobilityJob linked to this repair extends automatically with it.

actualCompletionAt.description: When the repair was actually finished

totalLoss.description: Declaring a total loss redirects the vehicle to a salvage destination and turns the replacement mobility from temporary into permanent

declared.description: Whether the vehicle has been declared a total loss

declaredByEName.description: eName of the person who declared the total loss

declaredAt.description: When the total loss was declared

reason.description: Why the vehicle is not worth repairing

workPerformed.description: Also written back to the vehicle eVault, so it stays with the vehicle

costRecordEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the record of what this repair cost. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
